study type: secondary analysis of a randomised controlled trial
exposure: Patients who did not receive periprocedural fluids
outcome: Incidence of post-endoscopic retrograde cholangiopancreatography pancreatitis
cohort: 960 patients at high-risk for post-endoscopic retrograde cholangiopancreatography pancreatitis who underwent endoscopic retrograde cholangiopancreatography
finding: Higher fluid volume and lactated Ringers use during the periprocedural period was associated with a decreased risk of post-endoscopic retrograde cholangiopancreatography pancreatitis and length of hospital stay.
